spans.s:
ओम ओम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अव्, cf. 4. ऊ), Ved.
a protector; any one favourably disposed (towards
another); any one worthy of favour or protection.

ओमन्, आ, m., Ved. protection, assistance; favour,
kindness; a kind person.
—ओमन्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. friendly, agreeable; favourable, kind; satiating.

ओमात्रा, f., Ved. protection, assistance, kindness,
readiness to help.
